summary: A user reported clicking a search engine result for Winna that led to a lookalike phishing site where they entered login credentials and a 2FA code. The attacker used the captured credentials to lock the victim out and likely drain the account.
user_mistake: Entered login credentials and 2FA code on a search result lookalike domain
prevention: Access crypto platforms only through bookmarked official domains / Verify exact domain spelling before entering credentials or 2FA codes
